author: More Perfect Union
description:
The Trump administration is cracking open the trillions sitting in Americans' retirement savings.

They want to change the rules so that your retirement funds aren't just invested in stable savings — but crypto and private equity, too.

The move could crush millions of retirement accounts.

Producer/Host: @ericgardner1
Editor: @discosludge
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Private equity is coming for your 401k: “It’s not going to end well”

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol made 1,794x the average worker at the company last year.

New ballot initiatives in LA and San Francisco would force big corps like Starbucks to close pay gaps — by penalizing companies that insist on paying CEOs huge salaries while workers suffer.

author: More Perfect Union
description:
We're giving the microphone to students and young renters to talk about their poor living conditions, sky-high rent, and their landlord's egregious business practices. Mayor Zohran Mamdani and Director of NYC's Office to Protect Tenants Cea Weaver will answer questions and talk about their plan to make New York City affordable for all. Eliza McLamb and Saphe will kick off the event with live music.
